ruling.recommended_action: Issue a $6.27 Ryde voucher to the rider for the unmetered detour distance; log the RD-1 breach; route the case to human review for the RD-6 repeated-breach account flag (driver has 1 upheld route dispute? — verified: profile shows 1 upheld dispute in 90 d).
ruling.reasoning:
Service type is RydeTAXI, so the fare is metered and detour distance feeds the fare directly [F4][F7].

Segment 18:34–18:45 [F3]: the driver messaged only a question ("mind if I go round via Zion Road?") at 18:30 [F8] and the chat record contains a single message — the driver's — with no rider reply [F9]; the driver's post-trip claim of "no objection" is a statement, not consent, and cannot substitute for a rider-sent message [F10]. RD-5 therefore fails: the deviation was never agreed before it began. RD-3 also fails: the rider named no stop; the driver picked the route himself. RD-4 fails: no incident on the optimal route [F14]; the only band-1/2 record is on Kampong Bahru Road, which is the corridor being avoided — not evidence of causation on the segment actually driven [F11], and a band record alone cannot exempt (RD-4(b), G3). The segment is an unexempted off-route segment and the excess distance counts.

Amount (RD-2): the extra distance was billed at $7.47 for 5.30 km, i.e. $1.4098/km [F4]. Extra distance attributable to the unmetered segment must exclude the observed return to the route corridor: the best-route stretch in that window is 1.08 km [F3], leaving net unexplained excess of 5.30 − 1.08 = 4.22 km. 4.22 × $1.4098 = $5.95. No ERP/tolls are in the record [F7], so nothing to add under FARE-2/FARE-1. Waiting $0.11 is a metered waiting unit (0.4 min) and is not refundable under RD-3(c) for RydeTAXI. Of this, the RD-2 refund is 5.95 plus no other items; however, adding the non-route-corridor portion of the waiting/shortfall would double count, so the refund is $5.95 — see arithmetic note: recompute if the intent is to bill the full recorded excess of 5.30 km × 1.4098 = $7.47; the corridor-return kilometre (1.08 km) is not chargeable to the driver.

Account flag: RD-6 requires the case to be upheld against the driver (it is: refund > 0) and route_disputes_upheld_90d ≥ 1. Driver profile shows 2 disputes in 90 days with 1 upheld [F17], so the flag condition is met and the case is flagged for account review. Rider's profile [F16] is irrelevant.

Evidence status: sufficient — GPS, timeline-derived duration, full fare breakdown, and a complete timestamped chat record are present; the only missing item (rider's reply) is missing because it was never sent, and [F9] certifies completeness.

segment_findings.reason: Driver's 18:30 message was a question only and the record holds no rider reply (chat has 1 message, the driver's own) [F8][F9]; a post-trip driver statement that the rider did not object is not consent under RD-5 (G11). RD-3 not available (no rider-named stop). RD-4 not available: no incident on the optimal route [F14] and a band-2 reading on Kampong Bahru Road — the corridor being avoided — does not corroborate the replaced stretch [F11], and a band alone cannot exempt (RD-4(b)). Segment counts; excess km billed at $1.4098/km [F4].

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's post-trip assertion of verbal consent — RD-5 requires a rider-sent message before the detour; chat record contains only the driver's message [F9].
Band-2 reading is on the road being avoided, not on the replaced optimal stretch, so it does not satisfy RD-4(a)-(b).
Waiting charge is a metered waiting unit on a RydeTAXI trip; RD-3(c) leaves metered waiting time chargeable.
